title: Grateful Dead Live at International Amphitheatre on 1973-02-19

ai_review.summary: Strong second‑set performance with a smoking 'The Other One' and groovy 'Eyes', captured on a mostly clear soundboard recording that has only a brief dip in quality.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a prime 1973 second set—‘He’s Gone’ into ‘Truckin’’ is well developed, and both ‘The Other One’ and the jam‑filled ‘Eyes’ are highlighted as standout moments. Soundboard sound is generally good, though reviewers note a slight dip in clarity during the opening lyrics of ‘Eyes’. Overall the show feels high‑energy and worth the time investment.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review; both musical performance and recording are rated positively (≈4/5) with a minor technical flaw, leading to an overall 4‑star assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard tape; slight dip in audio quality after 'The Other One' during the initial lyrics of 'Eyes', but otherwise crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows tightly with smooth transitions, especially the 'He’s Gone > Truckin'' pairing and the highlight of 'The Other One' leading into a jam‑rich 'Eyes'.
